shortDescription: Add or delete a single record in Hetzner DNS service

options.name: hetzner_api_token
options.description: The token for the new Hetzner DNS API. If not provided, will be read from the environment variable E(HETZNER_API_TOKEN). Exactly one of O(hetzner_token) and O(hetzner_api_token) must be provided.

options.name: hetzner_token
options.description: The token for the classic Hetzner DNS API. If not provided, will be read from the environment variable E(HETZNER_DNS_TOKEN). Exactly one of O(hetzner_token) and O(hetzner_api_token) must be provided.

options.name: prefix
options.description: The prefix of the DNS record. This is the part of O(record) before O(zone_name). For example, if the record to be modified is C(www.example.com) for the zone C(example.com), the prefix is V(www). If the record in this example would be C(example.com), the prefix would be V('') (empty string). Exactly one of O(record) and O(prefix) must be specified.

options.name: record
options.description: The full DNS record to create or delete. Exactly one of O(record) and O(prefix) must be specified.

options.name: state
options.description: Specifies the state of the resource record.

options.name: ttl
options.description: The TTL to give the new record, in seconds. This is not used for record deletion.

options.name: txt_character_encoding
options.description: Whether to treat numeric escape sequences (V(\\xyz)) as octal or decimal numbers. This is only used when O(txt_transformation=quoted). The default changed to V(decimal) in community.dns 3.0.0. Before, the default used to be V(octal). The value V(decimal) is compatible to L(RFC 1035, https://www.ietf.org/rfc/rfc1035.txt).

options.name: txt_transformation
options.description: Determines how TXT entry values are converted between the API and this module's input and output. The value V(api) means that values are returned from this module as they are returned from the API, and pushed to the API as they have been passed to this module. For idempotency checks, the input string will be compared to the strings returned by the API. options.name: type
options.description: The type of DNS record to create or delete.

options.name: value
options.description: The new value when creating a DNS record. When deleting a record all values for the record must be specified or it will not be deleted.

options.name: zone_id
options.description: The ID of the DNS zone to modify. Exactly one of O(zone_name) and O(zone_id) must be specified.

options.name: zone_name
options.description: The DNS zone to modify. Exactly one of O(zone_name) and O(zone_id) must be specified.
